anvil_trap.name: Anvil trap
anvil_trap.notes: Player-relative (feet block at 0,0,0). Iron-bar cage: stonebrick floor 3x3 at dy=-1, iron bars perimeter 3x3 from dy=0..2 (interior centre column stays open). Sign 'Look Up' on a stonebrick post outside the cage, 2 blocks out in the facing direction (dy=0, air at dy=1). Then the 1x64x1 column above the feet is cleared to air (dy=0..63) and two anvils are placed at dy=64 then dy=63. They fall by gravity onto the player; they are listed as falling entries with delay 0 (vanilla BlockFalling turns a placed anvil with air below into a falling entity at once; this step is not in the mod's bytecode). Nothing is checked before placing: existing blocks are overwritten.

lava_trap.name: Lava trap
lava_trap.notes: Player-relative. Iron-bar cage 3x3, 4 high (dy=0..3), stonebrick floor at dy=-1, same facing sign as the anvil trap. One flowing_lava block (meta 0) at dy=+3 centre, above the cage. The lava then flows down the open centre column in game (flow not replayed here).

water_trap.name: Water trap
water_trap.notes: Player-relative. Obsidian floor 3x3 at dy=-1, obsidian ring at dy=0, glass ring at dy=1, obsidian roof 3x3 at dy=2. Flowing water (meta 0) at the centre column dy=0 and dy=1, sealed under the roof. Direction independent.

pit_trap.name: Pit trap
pit_trap.notes: Player-relative. Clears a 3x60x3 shaft (dy=-60..-1) to air, then flowing_lava at dy=-59 and cobweb (web) at dy=-58 over the 3x3 footprint. The player falls onto the web over lava. Direction independent.

fort.name: Fort
fort.notes: Player-relative. Sandstone floor 5x5 at dy=-1; sandstone wall ring 5x5 two high (dy=0..1); air interior 3x2x3; gold blocks at the four top corners (dy=2). Four random lucky blocks at the interior corners at dy=0. Luck of each: random -100..100 (0 = no tile entity). Direction independent.
unresolved: random luck values (lucky blocks): not fixed in the structure

temple.name: Temple
temple.notes: Player-relative, stepped sandstone temple 7x7 footprint, 5 layers (dy=-1..3). Layer dy=-1 sandstone 7x7 floor. dy=0: sandstone_stairs ring 7x7 (meta by side) around an air 5x5 room. dy=1: stairs ring 5x5 with an air 3x3 inside. dy=2: stairs ring 3x3 with air at the centre. dy=3: gold block at the centre. Sandstone corner columns dy=0..2, gold corners at dy=3. Four torches at dy=1 around the centre (meta 3,2,4,1). Stair meta: 0 on the west column, 1 on the east column, 2 on the north row, 3 on the south row. Eight random lucky blocks at dy=0 on the room's corners (dx,dz = +-2) and edge midpoints ((+-2,0),(0,+-2)), each luck random -100..100 (0 = none). Direction independent.

bedrock_problem.name: Bedrock problem
bedrock_problem.notes: Bedrock is placed at the broken block's position, and a standing sign at dy=+1 (air at dy=+2). Lines: '', "Well, there's", 'your problem.'. The sign's meta is getPlayerDirection(player,16)+8 (16 buckets of 22 degrees, can reach 24 by integer division); meta 8 is shown here, the in-game sign faces the player.

lucky_choice.name: Lucky choice
lucky_choice.notes: Player-relative. Two lucky blocks two cells in front of the feet, side by side, with a sign between them. Luck pair: one is +100 (lucky), the other -100 (not), chosen by a coin flip at spawn (shown here with luck1=+100). The sign reads 'One is lucky.' / 'One is not.'. Positions depend on the facing (see by_facing).

chest.name: Chest
chest.notes: Block at the broken position: chest with meta from facing (meta 2/5/3/4 for dir 0/1/2/3, shown here for dir 0). Loot is filled immediately from the type named in the NBT tag. Types in the properties: bonusChest (luck 0), dungeonChest (luck 1), villageBlacksmith (luck 1), and the explicit items list (luck 2). Each roll picks one entry by weight, amount uniform in [minAmount, maxAmount] (an amount above the item's max stack size becomes that many single items), and the stack goes into a random chest slot via setInventorySlotContents, so a later roll can overwrite an earlier stack. Roll count: min if min>=max, otherwise min + random(max-min).

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.power_formula: 2 * damage, damage=6 from the properties line, so 12.0 (float)
explosion.notes: World.createExplosion(null, x, y, z, 2*damage, isSmoking=true) at the broken block's integer coordinates (block corner, not centre). The fire flag is false. No blocks are placed by this structure itself: the blast destroys blocks by the vanilla explosion rules.

wishing_well.name: Wishing well
wishing_well.notes: Block-relative. Clears a 1x256x1 column and a 5x20x5 room above the block. Iron block 3x1x3 at dy=-2, cobblestone ring 3x3 at dy=-1..0 (centre dy=-1 is a wooden pressure plate), fence corners at dy=+1..+2, stone_stairs ring 3x3 at dy=+3, glass at the top centre (dy=+3), flowing water in the centre at dy=0. The properties group also places lucky:lucky_block at dy=-3 with the wish message NBT; that block is not part of this list (it is not placed by CustomStructures). The NBT argument of makeWishingWell is not read by the bytecode.
